title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Hypertonic Washing of Plant Tissue Homogenates
author: Caroline Howard

steps.title: Aliquot frozen tissue samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 40 - 130 mg (70 - 90 mg recommended) of cryogenically disrupted frozen tissue samples into individual, labelled 2 mL Lobind tubes on a cold block on dry ice.

substeps.instruction: Optional: This can be done the day before and stored at -70°C.

steps.title: Prepare SHWB (Sorbitol Wash Buffer)
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of 'SHWB' (for 24 samples) by adding 46.32 mg DTT powder to 100 mL 'Sorbitol stock buffer'.

substeps.instruction: Ensure DTT is fully dissolved before use.
Store on wet ice and maintain at 4°C during use to prevent sample degradation.

steps.title: Prepare PBS-DTT wash buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 25 mL of cold 'PBS-DTT wash buffer' (for 24 samples) by adding 11.58 mg DTT powder (4°C).

substeps.instruction: Ensure DTT is fully dissolved by 'squishing DTT blobs'.

steps.title: Pre-incubate samples
steps.instruction: Transfer samples to a cold block on wet ice and incubate for 5-10 minutes.

steps.title: Perform sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Wash the samples using the cold sorbitol wash buffer (4°C).

substeps.instruction: Add 1.75 mL of cold sorbitol wash buffer (4°C) to all samples using a multipipette.
Vortex each sample continuously for 3 seconds at full speed until homogenous, returning each to the cold block on wet ice immediately after.
Inspect samples by inverting to mix; use a wide bore P1000 to thoroughly mix any samples with aggregated tissue that cannot be suspended by vortexing.
Incubate samples on the cold block on wet ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 10,000 x rpm at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by decanting and/or pipetting with a wide bore P1000, returning samples to a cold block on wet ice.
Carefully aspirate any gelatinous layer formed above the pelleted tissue using an appropriately sized wide bore tip (likely P200), avoiding disturbance of the pellet.

steps.title: Repeat sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the sorbitol wash process once more.

steps.title: Perform PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash the samples using the cold PBS-DTT wash buffer (4°C).

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL of cold 'PBS-DTT wash buffer' (4°C) to all samples using a multipipette.
Vortex each sample continuously for 3 seconds at full speed, returning each to the cold block on wet ice immediately after.
Immediately centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 10,000 x rpm at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by decanting and/or pipetting with a wide bore P1000, returning samples to a cold block on wet ice, avoiding disturbance of the pelleted tissue.

steps.title: Proceed to extraction
steps.instruction: Proceed directly to the extraction method of choice.

substeps.instruction: Keep samples on a cold block on wet ice until the extraction lysis buffer is added to the pellet.
